title: Use feed, vertical, and graph views
description: Choose a continuous playback layout or explore how tags connect.

blocks.text: Feed view stacks playable items in one scrolling column. Pair it with the Infinite page size when you want an uninterrupted browsing session.

blocks.alt: A Cove media list displayed in feed view

sections.title: Focus on one item at a time

blocks.text: Vertical view gives one item most of the viewport and moves through the result set item by item. Use it for short-form media when a dense grid would distract from playback.

blocks.alt: A Cove media list displayed in vertical view

sections.title: Explore relationships in the tag graph

blocks.text: The tag graph visualizes tag relationships. Use it to find clusters, notice overlapping labels, and open a tag directly from the graph.

blocks.alt: Cove tag graph showing connected tag nodes

blocks.text: A graph is most useful after tags have been applied consistently. Clean up duplicate or overly broad tags before drawing conclusions from the clusters.
